t: translation - How would you say, 「Will you please look at this picture?」 - Japanese Language Stack Exchange
s: Take, as an example' 「ビールをください」. While it could be translated as 'Beer please', it could also be translated as 'Give me a beer'. ください is just a more formal way of saying 'do this for me'. That small non-sequitur out of the way, a way to phrase it to sound more like a polite request would be to say: 「この画像／写真を見てださいませんか。」- 'Won't you look at this image/picture?'
